custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part, part A, with 4 on hand and a hyphen in its part number.
  • Have an active part, part B, with 4 on hand, so the lookup has a part it must still offer.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, and descriptions that start with the same text, so one search finds both.
  • Have a received vendor bill, bill A, with one line for a vendor part.
  • Start on bill A (Parts in the top bar, Vendor Invoices in the left menu, then bill A).

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425728 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425728-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 4. Click Save.
  2. Set part A inactive: On the Inventory page click Search and type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425728-A. Click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate.
  3. Make part B: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425728 PART B; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425728-B; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Quantity (in the bin row): 4. Click Save.
  4. The part numbers above both start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425728- and the descriptions start ZZAUTOTEST PL C425728 PART.
  5. Make the purchase order: Click Parts in the top bar, Purchase Orders in the left menu, then New PO. Pick any Vendor. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425728-VENDORPART in Part Number and keep it as typed (do not pick a result). Type 1 in Quantity, click Add, then click Save & Close. Do not click Receive.
  6. Receive it: On the Purchase Orders list click Receive on that purchase order's row. Type any number in Vendor Invoice #, pick an Invoice Date, type 1 in Qty received, then click the Receive Parts button. The received bill is listed under Vendor Invoices in the left menu.
